headline: Nevish and Kuura Flare as Mercy Holds Late Action
war_summary: Three hours further on finds Kuura Strand back in motion with five changes in the last two hours toward fifteen in the day at Faden Point and Menneen after silence in the prior edition, while Nevish Line posts four late changes toward seventeen in the day at Tomb Father and Blackcoat Way with the latest entry at the cutoff. Weathered Expanse ticks up to three late changes toward fifty-five in the day around Spirit Watch, Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, now counted at four Warden, two Colonial and three neutral. Linn Mercy eases to two late changes toward sixteen in the day centered on Outwich Ranch, now listed at two Warden, eight Colonial and one neutral with the latest entry at the cutoff. Pari Peak adds three late changes toward twenty-two in the day around Pariah. Marban Hollow, Stlican Shelf, Gutter and Olavis Wake record no change in the last two hours despite twenty-eight, thirteen, fifty-three and fourteen changes in the day. Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle still show heavy daily casualties without a recorded change.
